observations: Photo shows a Yamaha electronic keyboard with built-in speakers on both left and right ends.
Brand/model text appears on the control panel area: “YAMAHA” and “PSR-175”.
LCD screen is present but its contents are not clearly readable in the photo.
No visible power-on status, no audio/video of keys working, and no close-ups of ports/condition.

claims.evidence: No photo/video showing it powered on, playing, or any screen/controls functioning (photo 0 only shows the keyboard off).

claims.claim: it's used please note but working perfectly well
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a used-looking keyboard, but wear level and functional condition are not verifiable from a single still image.
Photo 0 shows “PSR-175” on the keyboard panel, not “275”.

risks.risk: Wrong model listed (seller says 275 but photo shows PSR-175), which changes value and parts compatibility.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear close-up photo of the model label/serial area and the exact model text on the panel (or a screenshot of the model shown in the menu if available).
risks.if_unproven: Price as the photo-confirmed model (PSR-175) but treat the seller’s description as unreliable until model is confirmed.

risks.risk: Not actually working (keys, speakers, LCD, power supply, or sound output may be faulty).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video: power on + LCD visible + play a few keys + demonstrate at least one sound/auto accompaniment, with volume audible.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst case: not guaranteed working (as-is / needs testing).

risks.risk: Hidden damage or missing accessories (power adapter, sustain pedal, cables) not shown in the photo.
risks.proof: Ask for photos of included items: power adapter, any pedals, and ports (rear panel) in close-up.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming missing/unknown accessories and possible need to buy adapter/pedal.

risks.risk: LCD/controls may be partially functional (screen may be dim/blank; buttons may stick).
risks.proof: Ask for a close-up photo of the LCD while powered on, plus a quick video pressing several buttons/menus.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming basic functions may be unreliable (LCD/controls not confirmed).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the model text/label showing the exact model (PSR-175 vs anything else).
Send a short video of powering on with the LCD readable, then playing keys with audible sound through the built-in speakers.
Confirm what accessories are included (power adapter, sustain pedal, any cables) with photos.
Show rear-panel ports and a close-up of the power/input area.
response.reason: The photo identifies the keyboard as Yamaha PSR-175, but the seller’s “model is 275” conflicts with the image, and “working perfectly” is not verifiable without power-on/audio proof. Request model confirmation and a working demonstration before pricing.
